title: Tekton EventListener
description: JSON schema for Tekton EventListener v1beta1

spec.description: EventListenerSpec defines the desired state of the EventListener, represented by a list of Triggers.

triggerGroups.description: TriggerGroups allow for centralized processing of an interceptor chain shared by several triggers.

name.description: Name must be unique within a namespace

namespace.description: Namespace defines the space within which each name must be unique

labels.description: Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize objects

annotations.description: Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource

uid.description: UID is the unique in time and space value for this object

resourceVersion.description: An opaque value that represents the internal version of this object

generation.description: A sequence number representing a specific generation of the desired state

creationTimestamp.description: CreationTimestamp is a timestamp representing the server time when this object was created

deletionTimestamp.description: DeletionTimestamp is RFC 3339 date and time at which this resource will be deleted

finalizers.description: Must be empty before the object is deleted from the registry

LocalObjectReference.description: LocalObjectReference contains enough information to let you locate the referenced object inside the same namespace

PodSecurityContext.description: PodSecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings

runAsUser.description: The UID to run the entrypoint of the container process

runAsGroup.description: The GID to run the entrypoint of the container process

runAsNonRoot.description: Indicates that the container must run as a non-root user

fsGroup.description: A special supplemental group that applies to all containers in a pod

Toleration.description: The pod this Toleration is attached to tolerates any taint that matches the triple <key,value,effect>

key.description: Key is the taint key that the toleration applies to

operator.description: Operator represents a key's relationship to the value

value.description: Value is the taint value the toleration matches to

effect.description: Effect indicates the taint effect to match

tolerationSeconds.description: TolerationSeconds represents the period of time the toleration tolerates the taint

EventListenerTrigger.description: EventListenerTrigger represents a connection between TriggerBinding, Params, and TriggerTemplate -- or, alternatively, a triggerRef pointing at a standalone Trigger instead.

triggerRef.description: TriggerRef, if set, delegates to a standalone Trigger's own bindings/template/interceptors instead of this entry's own.

serviceAccountName.description: ServiceAccountName optionally associates credentials with this one trigger, for more granular authorization than the EventListener's own.

EventListenerTriggerGroup.description: EventListenerTriggerGroup defines a group of Triggers that share a common set of interceptors.

triggerSelector.description: EventListenerTriggerSelector defines ways to select a group of triggers using their metadata.

TriggerSpecBinding.description: TriggerSpecBinding refers to a particular TriggerBinding resource, or embeds a name/value pair directly.

name.description: Name is the name of the binding param. Mutually exclusive with ref.

value.description: Value is the value of the binding param. Can contain JSONPath. Required if name is also specified.

ref.description: Ref is a reference to a TriggerBinding kind. Mutually exclusive with name.

kind.description: Kind can only be provided if ref is also provided. Defaults to TriggerBinding.

TriggerSpecTemplate.description: TriggerSpecTemplate refers to a particular TriggerTemplate resource, by ref or (rarely) an inline spec.

ref.description: Ref is the name of the referenced TriggerTemplate.

TriggerTemplateSpec.description: TriggerTemplateSpec defines the desired state of the TriggerTemplate.

params.description: Params is the list of parameters this TriggerTemplate declares; a Trigger/EventListener's bound TriggerBindings must supply a value for every one with no default.

resourcetemplates.description: ResourceTemplates is a list of resources to create (e.g. a PipelineRun), templated with $(tt.params.NAME). Each entry is an arbitrary Kubernetes resource manifest, not a fixed shape.

ParamSpec.description: ParamSpec defines a parameter a TriggerBinding/TriggerTemplate declares, to be supplied via a Param.

name.description: Name declares the name by which a parameter is referenced.

description.description: Description is a user-facing description of the parameter that may be used to populate a UI.

default.description: Default is the value a parameter takes if no input value via a Param is supplied.

TriggerInterceptor.description: TriggerInterceptor provides a hook to intercept and pre-process events.

name.description: Optional name to identify the current interceptor configuration.

params.description: Params are the params to send to the interceptor.

InterceptorRef.description: InterceptorRef provides a reference to a ClusterInterceptor/NamespacedInterceptor.

name.description: Name of the referent; More info: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/identifiers#names

kind.description: InterceptorKind indicates the kind of the Interceptor, namespaced or cluster scoped.

InterceptorParams.description: InterceptorParams defines a key-value pair that can be passed on an interceptor.

value.description: Value can be any JSON value (string, number, boolean, array, or object).

WebhookInterceptor.description: WebhookInterceptor refers to an old-style webhook interceptor service.

objectRef.description: ObjectRef is a reference to an object that will resolve to a cluster DNS name to use as the EventInterceptor. Either objectRef or url can be specified.

url.description: URL to use as the EventInterceptor, instead of objectRef.

header.description: Header is a group of key-value pairs appended to the interceptor request headers, letting the interceptor make decisions specific to an EventListenerTrigger.

Param.description: Param declares a value for a parameter a TriggerBinding declares.

NamespaceSelector.description: NamespaceSelector is a selector for selecting either all namespaces or a list of namespaces.

LabelSelector.description: A label selector is a label query over a set of resources.

kubernetesResource.description: KubernetesResource configures the Deployment/Service the EventListener's sink runs as.

spec.description: A Kubernetes PodSpec overlay for the sink Deployment's pod template -- not modeled field-by-field here (see the Task/Pipeline schemas for that level of detail on the pieces they share, like containers/securityContext); any object is accepted structurally.

customResource.description: CustomResource is an arbitrary Kubernetes resource manifest to use as the EventListener's sink, instead of the default Deployment/Service pair.
